#Test configurations for app-configuration.json
#Copy one block into app-configuration.json and run sdk.R.
#Template test data: input2 has height_above_ellipsoid (with values), input3 has argos_altitude,
#input4 has height_above_ellipsoid (only NA) and height_raw (text). Set SOURCE_FILE in .env accordingly.
#Every run writes height_columns_overview.csv if possible height columns exist.


########## Option 1: standard Movebank attribute from the list ##########

#Only ground elevation, no height above ground
#Expected: only ground.elevation is added; possible height columns are listed in the overview
{
  "height_selection": "select_height_attr_list",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Standard MSL height (height_above_msl or height_above_mean_sea_level)
#Expected: <column>.adapted = height - ground.elevation
{
  "height_selection": "select_height_attr_list",
  "height_attr_list": "height_above_msl_or_mean_sea_level",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Standard ellipsoid height (use input2)
#Expected: egm08.geoid added; height_above_ellipsoid.adapted = height - egm08.geoid - ground.elevation
{
  "height_selection": "select_height_attr_list",
  "height_attr_list": "height_above_ellipsoid",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Already height above ground
#Expected: height_above_ground_level.adapted = height_above_ground_level
{
  "height_selection": "select_height_attr_list",
  "height_attr_list": "height_above_ground_level",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Standard column with only NA values (use input4)
#Expected: not adapted, warning "contains no numeric values"
{
  "height_selection": "select_height_attr_list",
  "height_attr_list": "height_above_ellipsoid",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}


########## Option 2: type the exact column name ##########

#Custom column treated as MSL
#Expected: altitude.adapted = altitude - ground.elevation (warning if the column does not exist)
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "altitude",
  "height_type_freetext": "msl",
  "height_props": null
}

#Custom column treated as ellipsoid
#Expected: egm08.geoid added; altitude.adapted = altitude - egm08.geoid - ground.elevation
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "altitude",
  "height_type_freetext": "ellipsoid",
  "height_props": null
}

#Custom column treated as already ground level
#Expected: altitude.adapted = altitude
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "altitude",
  "height_type_freetext": "ground_level",
  "height_props": null
}

#Custom column with unknown type
#Expected: not adapted, warning to select the height type
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "altitude",
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Standard Movebank name typed with unknown type (use input2)
#Expected: the known type (ellipsoid) is used automatically
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "height_above_ellipsoid",
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Standard Movebank name typed with a WRONG type (use input2)
#Expected: adapted as msl, but warning "The values look more like type 'ellipsoid' than 'msl'"
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "height_above_ellipsoid",
  "height_type_freetext": "msl",
  "height_props": null
}

#Barometric height warning test
#Expected: not adapted, reason in log and overview (weather-dependent)
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "barometric_height",
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Raw height warning test (use input4)
#Expected: not adapted, reason in log and overview (text, reference unknown)
{
  "height_selection": "type_height_attr_name",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": "height_raw",
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#No column name given

  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "msl",
  "height_props": null
}


########## Option 3: all standard Movebank height attributes ##########

{
  "height_selection": "calculate_all_height_columns",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}

#Argos data, no standard height attribute (use input3)

{
  "height_selection": "calculate_all_height_columns",
  "height_attr_list": "no_selection",
  "height_attr_freetext": null,
  "height_type_freetext": "unknown",
  "height_props": null
}
